messages:
maria-cs: FYI — AcmeCorp raised an escalation: dashboard shows ~5.1M tokens for March but invoice total is much lower ($4,200). They want an explanation before EOD.
ajay-billing: Can you drop account + invoice id? I’ll pull the invoice adjustments.
maria-cs: acct_acme_001, invoice inv-2026-03-0091, customer reported on a call just now.
ajay-billing: thanks. grabbing quicks: 
```
SELECT SUM(tokens) as tokens_dashboard
FROM usage_aggregates
WHERE account_id='acct_acme_001' AND period='2026-03';

SELECT SUM(tokens) as tokens_metered
FROM metered_events
WHERE account_id='acct_acme_001' AND ts >= '2026-03-01' AND ts < '2026-04-01';
```
ajay-billing: initial look — dashboard agg = 5,083,210 tokens, metered_events = 4,010,432 tokens, invoice shows charge for ~4.01M tokens minus partner credits. So there are two orthogonal things: (1) dashboard is higher, (2) invoice has a partner credit applied after generation.
sophie-sre: pinging infra — any late ingestion or consumer lag that could explain events missing from metered_events at bill time? @ajay-billing curious about ingestion window used at invoice gen.
ajay-billing: invoice gen window was ts < 2026-04-01T00:00:00Z. metered_events query used same window. If there was delayed ingestion, those tokens would be absent.
sophie-sre: I see a consumer lag spike on kafka-consumer-usage between 2026-04-01T00:30:00Z and 2026-04-01T02:00:00Z — there was a brief outage during that hour and we processed ~1.1M tokens afterwards. Logs: 
```
2026-04-01T01:12:03Z INFO consumer processed 1123456 tokens for acct_acme_001 partition 7 (timestamped 2026-03-31T23:58:xx)
```
maria-cs: so some tokens had earlier event timestamps but were ingested after invoice cutoff? That would make dashboard (real-time) include them and invoice not.
dan-product: also found invoice_adjustments: partner_reseller_credit of -$900 applied on 2026-04-02, source=partner_portal. That would reduce invoice dollars but not affect dashboard tokens.
ajay-billing: putting together hypothesis: dashboard shows real-time aggregation (includes backfilled events once processed). Invoice was generated at cutoff using metered_events available at generation time (missing backfilled events). Then partner credit applied afterwards, further reducing invoice total. Two separate causes -> token delta and dollar delta stack.
maria-cs: customer is seeing both: higher dashboard tokens and invoice lower than expected. We need a concise explanation and next steps.
sophie-sre: remediation options: 
- Option A: backfill invoice by issuing an adjustment for the delayed ingestion tokens (requires finance approval).
- Option B: show a "post-cutoff backfills" section in dashboard so customers can see which tokens arrived after invoice cutoff. Quickest internal win is B.
ajay-billing: operational steps I ran: 
```
-- find delayed events
SELECT * FROM metered_events_raw
WHERE account_id='acct_acme_001' AND event_ts < '2026-04-01' AND ingested_at >= '2026-04-01T00:00:00Z';
```
Result: ~1,072,178 tokens ingested at 2026-04-01T01:12Z with event_ts before cutoff.
ajay-billing: finance: the credited amount is in invoice metadata, code: partner_credit_id=pc-7721. That credit is separate; dashboard doesn't apply partner credits.
dan-product: action items: (1) CS to send explanation to Acme with timelines + offer one-time goodwill credit for the gap; (2) Billing to open finance ticket to evaluate invoice adjustment if required; (3) Eng to add a dashboard annotation for month-end backfills and a short-term alert when ingestion lag > 5m around cutoff.
maria-cs: I'll draft a customer message now. Suggested phrasing: "We found two contributing factors: ingestion backfill of events with timestamps prior to the invoice cutoff (these were processed after the invoice generation) and a partner credit applied after invoice creation. The dashboard is near real-time and shows backfilled events, while invoices reflect metered events at the invoice generation time and any post-generation credits."
sophie-sre: tagging engineers: we should add a replay runbook for backfill detection. I can create a PR for alerting rule.
ajay-billing: opening internal ticket: BILL-3479 (investigate delayed ingestion + propose invoice adjustment policy). Assigning to @sophie-sre and @ajay-billing.
maria-cs: customer update done (sent at 14:05 PT). They asked if we can either reissue invoice or apply account credit — waiting on finance.
dan-product: I'll prioritize a dashboard explainer card in the next sprint; short-term we can expose "last ingested at" per-day so customers can self-check.
billing-bot: Note: invoice inv-2026-03-0091 has partner_credit pc-7721 (-$900) applied on 2026-04-02 by partner_portal.
ajay-billing: I'll follow up after finance decision. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
maria-cs: thanks team. closing this thread after finance confirms next steps. :white_check_mark:
